CREATE TABLE "public"."inquiries" (
  "academy_id" uuid,
  "ai_conversation_id" text,
  "asker_kind" text NOT NULL,
  "asker_member_id" uuid,
  "asker_staff_account_id" uuid,
  "category" text NOT NULL,
  "closed_at" timestamptz,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "first_response_due_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "idempotency_key" character varying(200) NOT NULL,
  "kind" text NOT NULL,
  "last_message_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "offering_id" uuid,
  "overdue_reminded_at" timestamptz,
  "refund_request_id" uuid,
  "related_settlement_ref" uuid,
  "reservation_id" uuid,
  "route" text DEFAULT 'human' NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'answer_waiting' NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "ck_inquiries_asker_b8f8336a" CHECK ((asker_kind = 'member' AND asker_member_id IS NOT NULL AND asker_staff_account_id IS NULL) OR (asker_kind <> 'member' AND asker_staff_account_id IS NOT NULL AND asker_member_id IS NULL)),
  CONSTRAINT "ck_inquiries_closed_3d83488f" CHECK ((status = 'closed') = (closed_at IS NOT NULL)),
  CONSTRAINT "ck_inquiries_idempotency_key_100850a9" CHECK (char_length(idempotency_key) > 0),
  CONSTRAINT "ck_inquiries_reservation_member_cbc47c77" CHECK (reservation_id IS NULL OR asker_kind = 'member'),
  CONSTRAINT "ck_inquiries_target_6b485064" CHECK ((kind = 'academy') = (academy_id IS NOT NULL)),
  CONSTRAINT "inquiries_asker_kind_check_d08a3764" CHECK ("asker_kind" IN ('member', 'instructor', 'owner')),
  CONSTRAINT "inquiries_category_check_f4d410d8" CHECK ("category" IN ('class', 'refund', 'schedule', 'settlement_basis', 'capacity', 'absence', 'account', 'app_error', 'payment_outage', 'membership', 'other')),
  CONSTRAINT "inquiries_kind_check_c310bb44" CHECK ("kind" IN ('academy', 'system')),
  CONSTRAINT "inquiries_route_check_9c12ab5f" CHECK ("route" IN ('human', 'ai_handoff')),
  CONSTRAINT "inquiries_status_check_fe07f0c8" CHECK ("status" IN ('answer_waiting', 'answered', 'closed', 'ai_answered'))
)

  "outcome" text,
  "outcome_note" text,

  "resolved_at" timestamptz,
  "resolved_by_account_id" uuid,
  "restriction_case_id" uuid,
  "reviewed_at" timestamptz,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'received' NOT NULL,
  "target_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "target_kind" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "ck_reports_idempotency_key_100850a9" CHECK (char_length(idempotency_key) > 0),
  CONSTRAINT "ck_reports_reporter_7c2264e4" CHECK ((reporter_kind = 'member' AND reporter_member_id IS NOT NULL AND reporter_staff_account_id IS NULL) OR (reporter_kind <> 'member' AND reporter_staff_account_id IS NOT NULL AND reporter_member_id IS NULL)),
  CONSTRAINT "ck_reports_resolved_8b216426" CHECK ((status = 'resolved') = (outcome IS NOT NULL AND resolved_at IS NOT NULL) AND (status = 'resolved' OR (outcome IS NULL AND resolved_at IS NULL))),
  CONSTRAINT "reports_outcome_check_082ffed4" CHECK ("outcome" IN ('dismissed', 'upheld')),
  CONSTRAINT "reports_reason_code_check_a51b0373" CHECK ("reason_code" IN ('off_platform_payment', 'info_mismatch', 'harassment', 'illegal_dangerous', 'other')),
  CONSTRAINT "reports_reporter_kind_check_88b38334" CHECK ("reporter_kind" IN ('member', 'instructor', 'owner')),
  CONSTRAINT "reports_status_check_103e43a0" CHECK ("status" IN ('received', 'in_review', 'resolved')),
  CONSTRAINT "reports_target_kind_check_57057f37" CHECK ("target_kind" IN ('academy', 'instructor', 'class', 'member'))
)
